title: Surface Plate Calibration and Conditioning
summary: A look at how granite surface plates are inspected, calibrated and reconditioned using an autocollimator, a repeat meter and diamond-charged cast iron laps. Measurements are at the level of millionths of an inch.
why: Cited in threads on flatness and precision as a glimpse into a niche metrology profession.

quote.text: I like the glimpse into the hobby/profession shown on channels like this
